steps.description: Design and execute a numerical experiment to test the hypothesis on "solution space rigidity" in small feedforward networks. Steps:

Conduct a targeted numerical experiment to test the concentration of measure hypothesis on solution space rigidity. Generate a smooth analytic target function (e.g., a high-degree polynomial or trigonometric combination), sample w constraint points (w ∈ {10, 20, 30, 50, 100}), train small feedforward networks (1-2 hidden layers, tanh activation) with widths N_h ∈ [4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128], and compute the minimal N_c(w) achieving ≤1e-3 absolute error on a held-out validation set of 100 independent points. Fix random seeds, use Adam with early stopping, and record training/validation MSE and N_c(w) trend.
